_comment: Uni-Mol v1's self-supervised objective on a DPA4 backbone. The element head reads the per-atom representation as Uni-Mol's does; the coordinate head reads the backbone's equivariant state, because DPA4 carries no pair channel; the distance head describes a pair by its two endpoints, for the same reason.

model._comment_type_map: [MASK] is the pseudo-element a corrupted atom is carried as; the objective needs it

fitting_net._comment_dist_coverage: follow the backbone's neighbour list, which is what the rest of deepmd trains on; set all_pairs to cover every pair as Uni-Mol does, at quadratic cost and without sharing that locality

loss._comment: Uni-Mol's two norm regularisers constrain quantities belonging to its own transformer and have no counterpart here, so they carry no weight; a DPA backbone also wraps no virtual tokens around a molecule

training_data._comment: an LMDB dataset path, given as a string; build it with deepmd.utils.unimol_data
